title: 宽依赖 / 窄依赖与 Shuffle 边界：Stage 切分与 Shuffle 次数
code:
WIDE = {"join", "groupByKey", "reduceByKey", "distinct", "sortBy", "repartition",
        "groupBy", "cogroup", "intersection"}
NARROW = {"map", "filter", "flatMap", "mapPartitions", "union", "coalesce", "sample"}

OPS = ["map", "filter", "join", "map", "reduceByKey", "filter", "sortBy", "map"]


def split_stages(ops):
    stages = []
    cur = []
    shuffles = 0
    for op in ops:
        cur.append(op)
        if op in WIDE:
            stages.append(cur)
            cur = []
            shuffles += 1
    if cur:
        stages.append(cur)
    return stages, shuffles


stages, shuffles = split_stages(OPS)

print("算子序列: " + " -> ".join(OPS))
print("分类为窄依赖的算子: " + str(sorted(o for o in OPS if o in NARROW)))
print("分类为宽依赖的算子: " + str(sorted(o for o in OPS if o in WIDE)))
print("")

wide_seen = 0
for i, st in enumerate(stages):
    tail = st[-1]
    if tail in WIDE:
        wide_seen += 1
        print("Stage " + str(i) + ": " + " -> ".join(st) +
              "     [末尾 " + tail + " 为宽依赖 -> Shuffle #" + str(wide_seen) + "]")
    else:
        print("Stage " + str(i) + ": " + " -> ".join(st) + "     [全窄依赖，pipeline 无 Shuffle]")

print("")
print("Stage 总数 = " + str(len(stages)))
print("Shuffle 次数 = " + str(shuffles))
print("判据 Shuffle 次数 == 宽依赖算子数: " +
      str(shuffles == len([o for o in OPS if o in WIDE])))
print("判据 Stage 数 == Shuffle 次数 + 1: " + str(len(stages) == shuffles + 1))
print("判据 每个 Stage 内部均为窄依赖 pipeline: " +
      str(all(o not in WIDE for st in stages for o in st[:-1])))
expected_output:
算子序列: map -> filter -> join -> map -> reduceByKey -> filter -> sortBy -> map
分类为窄依赖的算子: ['filter', 'filter', 'map', 'map', 'map']
分类为宽依赖的算子: ['join', 'reduceByKey', 'sortBy']

Stage 0: map -> filter -> join     [末尾 join 为宽依赖 -> Shuffle #1]
Stage 1: map -> reduceByKey     [末尾 reduceByKey 为宽依赖 -> Shuffle #2]
Stage 2: filter -> sortBy     [末尾 sortBy 为宽依赖 -> Shuffle #3]
Stage 3: map     [全窄依赖，pipeline 无 Shuffle]

Stage 总数 = 4
Shuffle 次数 = 3
判据 Shuffle 次数 == 宽依赖算子数: True
判据 Stage 数 == Shuffle 次数 + 1: True
判据 每个 Stage 内部均为窄依赖 pipeline: True
